basic_details.short_information: Update 31 Oct 2026: CSIR-AMPRI has extended the online application deadlines under Advertisement No. RECT-02/2026. The last date for Technical Officer and Technician (1) posts is now 13 November 2026 (earlier 06 November 2026), while the deadline for Security Officer, Security Assistant and Multi-Tasking Staff posts is 23 November 2026 (earlier 16 November 2026). Both application portals will close at 5:30 PM on their respective last dates. Check Official Corrigendum.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official CSIR-AMPRI website. Applicants should complete the application process before the revised deadline for their respective posts.
Visit the official website at ampri.res.in.
Open the recruitment section and select Advertisement No. RECT-02/2026.
Choose the appropriate online application link for the post you wish to apply for.
Complete the registration process using the required personal and contact details.
Fill in the application form with accurate educational, personal and experience information.
Pay the prescribed application fee, if applicable, using the authorised payment method.

Download and retain a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CSIR-AMPRI has announced 14 vacancies across five post categories. The post-wise vacancies, reservation details, pay levels and upper age limits are provided below. Note: The Technician (1) vacancies include two anticipated vacancies under Post Codes TC-03 and TC-04 arising from superannuation within the next year. The approximate monthly emoluments include applicable allowances as specified in the recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for CSIR-AMPRI Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the nationality, educational qualification, experience and age requirements prescribed for their respective posts. Applicants must be citizens of India. Note: Candidates applying for Security Officer, Security Assistant and Technician posts should carefully check the detailed experience, trade and equivalent qualification requirements in the official notification before applying.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. in Material Science / Physics or equivalent with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA.
MCA or equivalent with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA.
M.Sc. in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Chemical Sciences or equivalent with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA.
B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering / Metallurgy / Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA.
B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics / Instrumentation Engineering or equivalent with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA.

Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) or equivalent rank in other paramilitary forces, with the prescribed security experience. Special experience provisions apply to specified officer and inspector categories.
Ex-Servicemen JCO in the Army or equivalent rank in other paramilitary forces with at least five years of security experience.
10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with the prescribed ITI / Trade Certificate, apprenticeship or work experience in Instrument Mechanic trade.
10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with the prescribed ITI / Trade Certificate, apprenticeship or work experience in Fitter trade.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive pay according to the applicable 7th CPC pay matrix level, along with admissible allowances under CSIR rules. Applicable benefits may include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) and other facilities according to CSIR rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Applicable application fees must be paid online through SBI Collect or the prescribed payment gateway. The fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post code must follow the separate application and fee requirements.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure depends on the post applied for and may include screening, trade tests, physical tests, skill assessments and competitive written examinations. Technical Officer: Screening, qualifying Trade Test and Competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability), Paper II (General Awareness and English Language) and Paper III (Concerned Subject). Final merit is based on the prescribed written examination papers. Security Officer: Screening, physical standards and physical tests, followed by written examination covering mental ability, personality assessment and security-related subjects. Security Assistant: Screening, qualifying skill / physical and personality assessment tests, followed by a competitive written examination. Technician (1): Qualifying Trade Test followed by a competitive written examination covering mental ability, general awareness, English language and the relevant trade subject. Multi-Tasking Staff: Competitive written examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 questions, 75 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 75 marks), General Awareness (50 questions, 150 marks) and English Language (50 questions, 150 marks). The examination comprises 150 questions carrying 450 marks , with one negative mark for each incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 is 13 November 2026 for Technical Officer and Technician (1) posts, and 23 November 2026 for Security Officer, Security Assistant, and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) posts. Candidates must submit their applications by 5:30 PM on the respective closing dates through the official website, ampri.res.in.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies have been announced across Technical Officer, Security Officer, Security Assistant, Technician (1), and Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, women, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the fee upon uploading valid certificates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Technician (1) posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects (minimum 55% marks) along with an ITI certificate in the respective trade (Instrument Mechanic, Fitter, Machinist, or Laboratory Assistant Chemical Plant) or relevant apprenticeship/work experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any negative marking in the written examination?
faq.answer: Yes, negative marking applies to papers specified in the notification (generally one negative mark for every wrong answer in objective tests, while Paper I for Technical Officer and Technician (1) has no negative marking).

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for multiple post codes?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for multiple post codes provided they satisfy eligibility criteria, but they must submit a separate application and pay the required fee for each post code.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the examinations be conducted?
faq.answer: Examinations and tests will ordinarily be held at CSIR-AMPRI, Bhopal, or other designated centers as specified by the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Do working professionals need to submit an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, regular employees working in CSIR, Government departments, autonomous bodies, statutory bodies, universities, or PSUs must upload a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.
